title: NormalizedIssue
description: Canonical issue shape written to /tmp/ii_normalized.json by every provider after fetching. All consumers (SKILL.md Steps 3-6) read only this file.

id.description: Canonical issue identifier: Jira key (PROJ-123), GitLab/GitHub number as string

state.description: Normalized across providers. GitLab 'opened'→'open'. Jira 'In Progress'→'in_progress', 'Done'/'Resolved'/'Closed'→'closed', else 'open'.

url.description: Canonical web URL to open the issue in a browser

author.description: Display name or username of the reporter/creator

assignees.description: Display names or usernames of current assignees

labels.description: Label names. For Jira: labels + component names combined.

description.description: Plain text body. ADF (Jira) must be flattened before writing here.

comments.description: Human comments only, ascending order, max 10.

linked_issues.description: Related/linked issues. Empty array if description was sufficient and Step C was skipped.

issue_type.description: Derived from issue type field (Jira: issuetype.name) or labels (GitLab/GitHub). Used to choose branch prefix: bug/ or feature/.

custom_fields.description: Optional provider-specific fields (e.g. priority, sprint, story points). Key-value pairs rendered under '--- Provider Fields ---' in Step 6.
